title: SDP observation structures metadata schema
description: Optional logical observation structures that declare the grain of individual measures in wide or mixed-grain tables.

fields.name: observation_structure_id
fields.description: Package-local identifier for one measure-specific logical observation structure.

fields.name: structure_label
fields.description: Human-readable name for the logical observation structure.

fields.name: structure_description
fields.description: Description of what one logical observation represents and why the selected dimensions define its grain.

sdp:rowRule: One row per measure-specific logical observation structure. Each structure has exactly one measure component and at least one dimension component in observation_components.csv.
